strings.name: J. M. G. Le Clézio
strings.summary: Born in Nice with deep family ties to Mauritius, Le Clézio moved from linguistic experimentation toward migration, colonialism and encounters between civilizations. He lived in Mexico and Panama and encountered Indigenous cultures. His debut The Interrogation won the Renaudot Prize; Desert broadened his recognition. Awarded the 2008 Nobel Prize, he links family memory with experiences beyond Europe through fiction, travel writing and essays.
